key_difference: (D) reimplements the clear logic in QThreadStorageData::clear() (its own tls lookup, destructor-map lookup under destructorsMutex, and exchange-then-destroy) instead of guarding on QThreadData::currentThreadData() and reusing set(nullptr) as (B) does, which duplicates set()'s internals and lets a value stored by the destructor survive where set() would overwrite it.
